analysis.amplitude-square: A=.002,.004,.008 amplitude-normalized single-pulse trace differences <5%; weak log slope within 0.1 of two on every grid.
analysis.conservation: Maximum charge relative error <1e-5 and matched discrete energy residual/initial incident energy <1% for every grid and nonquiet case.
analysis.frozen-core-control: Executed incomplete Taylor replay gives max absolute delta_chi2 and delta_chi_dot2 <1e-15, while full single response RMS >5e-13 m.
analysis.frozen-inputs: Saved Test 6 profile/eigenmode hashes match exactly; finer h=.025 uses documented natural cubic interpolation of the frozen h=.05 data, no calibration fit.
analysis.local-markers: Every nonquiet case on every grid has a first rising and subsequent last falling |a|=1e-4 local crossing in t=0..100; predicted marker times within 0.1 m^-1 of observed events. Quiet has no neutral markers and is only a matched counterfactual reference.
analysis.marker-prediction: For each selected local interval, standalone precomputed marker/phase record differs by <= max(5% of actual interval record, its registered absolute error budget). If interval not resolved, unresolved.
analysis.numerical-controls: Each relative chi response L2 difference (fine/base, time/base, wide/base, finer/fine) <5% in single, second, both and phase controls.
analysis.prediction-first: Surface, reconstructed inputs, calibration and all prediction hashes verify; all prediction locks precede the first nonlinear receiver-start event.
analysis.pulse-overlap: Both-minus-each-alone chi trace is >5 times direct mesh+time+box+1e-13 m/sample budget and its predicted residual <=max(5%, inverse signal/error ratio); otherwise unresolved.
analysis.record-resolution: For nominal single, second, both and changed-phase interval records on h=.025, |delta_N| > 5*(|finer-fine|+|base-time|+|base-wide|+1e-11 cycles). Otherwise unresolved.
analysis.sign-even: Single and pair sign-odd/even local trace norm ratio <1e-5 on every grid.
analysis.surface-prediction: Fine-grid (h=.025) local chi trace prediction relative L2 error <= max(5%, direct mesh+time+box L2 error plus 1e-13 m/sample floor, divided by signal norm), for single, second, both and phase controls.
